# aggregate

In [EhOsContract.Contract](contract-dsl.md), section `contract`.

```elixir
aggregate name, label
```

A unit that decides over one stream, identified by its identity.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-aggregate-name"></a>`name` | `atom` | yes |  | The aggregate's name. |
| <a id="contract-aggregate-label"></a>`label` | `String.t` | yes |  | What the business calls it. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-aggregate-identity"></a>`identity` | `atom \| list(atom)` | yes |  | The fields that identify one aggregate; injected into its state, commands and events. |
| <a id="contract-aggregate-generated"></a>`generated` | `:uuid` |  |  | That the library gives a new aggregate its identity, a UUIDv7, when a command that `creates:` it arrives without one; written `identity :booking_id, generated: :uuid`. |
| <a id="contract-aggregate-source"></a>`source` | `String.t` |  |  | Where the aggregate comes from in the material. |

Inside it: [`command`](#contract-aggregate-command), [`state`](#contract-aggregate-state), [`invariant`](#contract-aggregate-invariant), [`event`](#contract-aggregate-event), [`stage`](#contract-aggregate-stage), [`lifecycle`](#contract-aggregate-lifecycle).

## aggregate.command

```elixir
command name, label
```

An intention an actor or a reaction issues to a unit.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-aggregate-command-name"></a>`name` | `atom` | yes |  | The command's name. |
| <a id="contract-aggregate-command-label"></a>`label` | `String.t` | yes |  | What the business calls it. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-aggregate-command-emits"></a>`emits` | `atom \| list(atom)` | yes |  | The events of this unit it may produce. |
| <a id="contract-aggregate-command-by"></a>`by` | `atom \| list(atom)` |  | `[]` | The actors who may issue it. |
| <a id="contract-aggregate-command-rejects"></a>`rejects` | `atom \| list(atom)` |  | `[]` | The invariants of this unit, and the constraints of this command, it may refuse on. |
| <a id="contract-aggregate-command-creates"></a>`creates` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Whether it creates the aggregate, which the library then gives its generated identity. |
| <a id="contract-aggregate-command-scope"></a>`scope` | `atom` |  |  | The field a grant narrows it to: a field of the command, and a scope of every actor in `by:`. |
| <a id="contract-aggregate-command-source"></a>`source` | `String.t` |  |  | Where the command comes from in the material. |
| <a id="contract-aggregate-command-from"></a>`from` | `atom \| list(atom)` |  | `[]` | The statuses of its aggregate's lifecycle it may be issued in; dispatch refuses it in any other, before the decision, on `or_rejects:`. |
| <a id="contract-aggregate-command-or_rejects"></a>`or_rejects` | `atom` |  |  | The invariant of the unit it is refused on outside the statuses in `from:`. |

Inside it: [`field`](#contract-aggregate-command-field), [`constraint`](#contract-aggregate-command-constraint).

| <a id="contract-aggregate-command-field-supplied_by"></a>`supplied_by` | `:host` |  |  | Who gives this field's value instead of the caller: `:host`, through `EhOsContract.Supplier`, for a value a decision depends on that a request could otherwise forge.
